business.summary: India's largest carbon black maker (6th largest globally, 4th in specialty blacks per company) and, since Jan-2024, owner of Aquapharm (phosphonates, oil & gas chemicals, polymers, green chelates). Carbon black is a reinforcing filler made by partially burning heavy oil (CBFS, ~90-95% of material cost, ~90% imported, ~75% from the US Gulf Coast); ~57% of PCBL's carbon black goes to tyres. Tail gas from the reactors feeds 122 MW of co-generation; surplus power is sold to the grid. Battery materials (Nanovace nano-silicon, super-conductive carbons, acetylene black) are pre-revenue.

capacity.plants: Carbon black: Mundra 245, Durgapur 163, Palej 142, Chennai 147 (+90 Q4FY26), Kochi 93 kt (Sep-2025 split, before the Tamil Nadu and Mundra lines). Aquapharm: Mahad, Pirangut, Jeddah, Texas.

business.customers: Formula-priced annual contracts with tyre majors (quarter or month lag to crude/CBFS); ~one-third of volume sold spot. Two Carbon Black customers each >10% of revenue: ₹1,959 cr in FY26 (₹2,429 cr FY25).

segmentsReported.note: Ind AS 108: Carbon Black, Power, Chemicals, Battery Chemical. FY26 segment PBIT: CB ₹721 cr (D&A ₹167 cr), Power ₹239 cr (D&A ₹50 cr; revenue ₹366 cr incl. ₹131 cr captive power to CB), Chemicals ₹17 cr (D&A ₹143 cr), Battery −₹0.15 cr; unallocated expenses (net) −₹275 cr. FY25: CB ₹1,042 cr, Power ₹186 cr, Chemicals ₹66 cr. Q1FY27: CB ₹316 cr, Power ₹79 cr, Chemicals ₹11 cr. Segment assets Mar-26: CB ₹5,422 cr, Power ₹585 cr, Chemicals ₹4,226 cr, Battery ₹246 cr.

q1fy27.realisation: Up ~₹27,000/t QoQ, of which ₹11,000-12,000 margin from spot pricing (CFO); Brent averaged $97 vs $78 in Q4FY26
q1fy27.aquapharm: Revenue ₹394 cr, EBITDA ₹47 cr, volume 22,985 t (−12% YoY; oil & gas −35%); no surcharge assumed for rest of year; new CEO Rohit Narang (ex-Eastman) declined to reaffirm the ₹75 cr/quarter target
q1fy27.power: 217 MU generated, 130 MU sold at ₹5.39/kWh (Q4FY26 ₹3.66); power EBIT up ~₹30 cr QoQ

fy27.value: Carbon black volume: 'high single-digit' growth (Apr-2026), reaffirmed Jul-2026 with a soft Q2 ('timing effect'). EBITDA/t +14-15% on FY26's ₹14,939, i.e. ~₹16,500-17,000 (reaffirmed 29-Jul-2026). Aquapharm: revenue +20-25% and ₹50-55 cr EBITDA a quarter (Apr-2026); ₹75 cr/quarter run-rate 'over the next 2-3 quarters' (Apr-2026), not reaffirmed in Jul-2026. Capex ~₹300 cr ±₹50 cr. Cost savings ₹200-250 cr over 4-6 quarters.

vision2030.value: From FY25: revenue 2x (₹8,400 → ₹16,000 cr), EBITDA 3x (~₹1,400 → ~₹4,000 cr), PAT 5x, EBITDA margin 16.5% → 24%, specialty share of revenue 28% → 45% and of EBITDA 28% → 63%, net debt/EBITDA 3.6x → <1x. EBITDA bridge: cost/efficiency ₹150 cr, carbon black capacity (TN brownfield + AP greenfield) ₹400 cr, conductives & battery materials ₹1,400 cr, Aquapharm ₹600 cr, specialty black ₹100 cr. Reaffirmed Apr-2026 (CFO). Long-term carbon black EBITDA/t aspiration ₹24,000-25,000 in ~5 years (Feb-2026).

history.event: Incorporated in 1960 as Phillips Carbon Black; carbon black production from 1962 at Durgapur (capacity 14,000 tpa then, per CARE)
RP-Sanjiv Goenka group company; plants at Durgapur, Kochi, Mundra and Palej with co-generation power from tail gas; Chennai (Tamil Nadu) plant built through subsidiary PCBL (TN)
Equity capital ₹34 cr → ₹38 cr and promoter stake 53.6% → 51.4% (issue details not covered in what we read); stock split ₹2 → ₹1 (Mar-2022); company later renamed PCBL Ltd and then PCBL Chemical Ltd
Carbon black volumes 389 kt → 532 kt; specialty blacks 24 kt → 57 kt; EBITDA per tonne ₹13,300 → ₹19,300 (ICICI Direct, company data)

Agreement (28-Nov-2023) to buy 100% of Aquapharm for ₹3,800 cr (Aquapharm FY23: revenue ₹2,045 cr, EBITDA ₹417 cr); completed Jan-2024, "majorly debt funded" (CARE); borrowings ₹1,029 cr (Mar-23) → ₹4,983 cr (Mar-24)
Nanovace Technologies JV (PCBL 51%) with Kindia, Australia, for nano-silicon battery materials
Aquapharm merged into Advaya Chemical (ACIL): ₹554 cr deferred-tax reversal offset by a ₹555 cr goodwill impairment; 1.6 cr warrants issued to promoter entities at ₹280 (₹448 cr)
RPSG Investor Day: Vision 2030 (EBITDA 3x to ~₹4,000 cr, net debt/EBITDA <1x)
MD Kaushik Roy resigns; Nilesh Koul MD from 3-Nov-2025 (5 years); warrants converted in Q3FY26 (shares 37.75 cr → 39.35 cr; promoters 51.41% → 53.38%)

CRISIL, ICRA and CARE move outlooks to Negative; 90 kt Tamil Nadu line (Q4FY26) and 20 kt Mundra specialty line (Q1FY27) take capacity to 900 kt; record Q1FY27 EBITDA helped by ~₹70 cr of inventory gains
